name: Hornero AI Usage
description: Agent Deck: every discovered coding-agent subscription in one place - provider-reported quota windows with resets, plans, and local activity. Unavailable quotas are labelled unknown, never guessed.
author: HorneroOS contributors

warningPercent.description: Quota used percent that counts as approaching a limit.

statsWindow.description: Activity window for Agent Deck daily statistics.

changelog.notes: Guard process exit codes, combo bounds, vertical bar layout, and user-facing copy
Gate local countdown tick timers in Agents and Bar on root.visible (HorneroOS/plugins#112).
Optional governed companion reaction when a verified quota crosses the warning threshold, and the All window now states it means all available daily history (up to 90 days).

Holistic daily statistics with an activity-window selector (7/30/60/90/all, segmented on wide screens, dropdown when compact): an all-agents daily chart and windowed per-provider totals over the backend's 90-day real buckets, filtered locally from cached records.

Agents page scrolls inside the room the dashboard offers, uses the full width with two-column instrument modules, and charts real per-day token activity (horneroctl recentDays) plus an in/out/cache partition. No invented series.
Fix quota windows collapsing to the legacy single meter: JSON arrays lose Array identity across QML property boundaries, so every provider window now renders (live-host find).

Agent Deck (PluginKit 5): a top-level Agents dashboard page, real subscription quota windows with reset countdowns (Claude Code, Codex, Muse Code, Cursor) over horneroctl schema v2, a tightest-quota bar indicator, and a richer popover. Needs a PluginKit 5 shell and a horneroctl with agent usage schema v2; older backends keep the legacy fallback.
Catalogue description no longer leads with an internal version; it says what the extension does first.
PluginKit 3 on Hornero Signal: instrument module header and a segmented quota meter that appears only when the provider reports a limit; quota stays unknown otherwise.
Popover actions use the native full-width UiActionRow (shell 1.2.79 PluginKit) instead of small buttons.
